title: Q3 2025 Platform Engineering Report
author: Platform Engineering
overview_paragraphs: This report summarizes Q3 2025 platform-engineering deliverables for internal distribution. It is intended as a round-trip-safe Word document suitable for review comments, track-changes editing, and PDF export.

Three themes dominate the quarter: reliability improvements on the request path, developer productivity gains from the new CI image, and a sharper security posture after the Q2 audit follow-ups landed.
action_items: Upgrade CI runners to the 2025.09 base image before October close
Migrate the remaining three services off the legacy message queue
Schedule the Q4 security review with vendor coverage locked in
appendix_entries: Mean time to recovery from an incident, measured from page to resolution.
A production release via the standard pipeline, counted regardless of traffic percentage.
